description: "Falkland" by Edward Bulwer-Lytton is a novel likely written in the early 19th century. It tells the story of Erasmus Falkland, a complex character struggling with the challenges of love, loss, and personal philosophy, as he reflects on his life and relationships in a narrative that intertwines his reclusive nature with his encounters in society.
